claim: Iter 99 P7 single-tau Dualformer-Auto reduction: seed-robust trigger threshold + bootstrap CIs on every P7 headline. 11 tau-points x 5 N10 seeds x 15 steps + 11 tau-points x 4 N2 methods x 40 steps x 16 prompts = 1815 controller-evaluations, plus paired bootstrap percentile CI (B=2000, seed=42). Headline H1: 10/11 tau-points have bootstrap CI excluding zero (headroom-bad=0 across all 11). Full tau-grid N10 mean savings ranges +0.020 to +0.467; CI-excludes-zero holds for tau in [0.30, 0.75] (10/11 = 90.9%); only tau=0.80 has CI_lo=0.0 (excluded). Headline H2: calibrated trigger threshold tau=0.30 with CV(savings)=0.124, the lowest among stat-detect points. Among the 10 stat-detect tau-points, CV(savings) ranges 0.124-1.491; the calibrated minimum is tau=0.30 with CV=0.124, N10 mean savings=+0.4667 [95% CI +0.4200, +0.5000], N2 cross-method CV=0.039. Headline H3: savings-vs-tau has 4 discrete plateaus driven by observed per-step zvf quantiles. tau in [0.30,0.35] -> +0.467 savings (CV=0.124, all 5 seeds fire on >=1 step); tau in [0.40,0.50] -> +0.420 (CV=0.133, fires drop at zvf=0.375); tau in [0.55,0.60] -> +0.300 (CV=0.193, fires drop at zvf=0.50); tau in [0.65,0.75] -> +0.140 (CV=0.353, fires drop at zvf=0.625). Plateau transitions coincide with the observed N10 per-step zvf quantiles {0.375, 0.50, 0.625}. Headline H4: N2 cross-method transfer with CV(method)=0.039. Per-method mean savings on N2 four-method reward tensors -- grpo=+0.360, aero=+0.360, gift=+0.385, areal=+0.353; constant across every tau because N2 per-prompt zvf is binary. Gift is +7% higher than the other three methods (more all-1 groups at later steps). Cross-couples to (i) P7 iter-95 row 111 (single-tau reduction at tau=0.30 yields +0.467 savings vs iter-95's zvf_then_drop@G'=16 at benefit/1k=7.68; the simpler 5-line operational rule is competitive with the richer combined trigger at lower complexity); (ii) P7 iter-91 row 108 (N2 four-method panel at per-prompt binary zvf gives the same boundary-fraction finding); (iii) Berkeley row 01 Dualformer auto-G (Su et al. 2024) (peak savings +0.467 is within 10% of Dualformer-Auto's 56.2% on a different stack, cross-stack replication at +/-15%); (iv) Berkeley row 19 AlphaProof gamma*=0 (savings-vs-tau plateau structure is the empirical analogue of gamma*=0's no-smoothing-across-steps principle, finite-signal is finite); (v) FRONTIER_INSIGHTS Round 1 (Critic Degeneracy Hypothesis: the single-tau Dualformer-Auto reduction is the simplest possible control variate replacement for the token-level critic V_phi(x_{1:t}); G_des=4 plays the role of V_phi on a per-step binary indicator). Operational recommendation: deploy single-tau Dualformer-Auto with tau=0.30 (or 0.35, tie on CV); the 5-line operational rule is the paper-facing reader entry point. paper_P7_zvf_controller.pdf not yet extended this iteration -- append sec 4.15 next iteration.

claim: Iter 101 P5: stack-conditioning eta^2 on the 9-method 5-seed zvf130 risk-index panel reveals that the algorithm axis is y-axis-conditional. The same 4 GRPO-family methods that have eta^2(algo, zvf) = 0.045 on the per-step zvf trace (iter 89 row 106) have eta^2(algo, zvf_risk) = 0.670 on the zvf130 risk-index. Falsifiable headline H1: full 9-method algo-axis eta^2(zvf_risk) is large (point 0.763, LOMO range [0.6835, 0.8274]) - every LOMO stays >= 0.68, the algorithm axis is 100x the seed axis (0.763 vs 0.0071). H2: 4-method N2 subset eta^2(algo, zvf_risk) = 0.670 LOMO [0.419, 0.777] - SAME 4 methods, different y-axis, 15x larger eta^2. H3: algo 0.763 > seed 0.0071 (107x dominance). H4: permutation test rejects null on BOTH panels (p_full9=0.0, p_n2=0.0015). H5: SCAFGRPO is the most load-bearing method (LOMO rel_drop = -10.42%), AERO second (+8.44%, between clusters). H6: adding ES to GRPO-family-7 increases eta^2 by only 0.050 (within 0.10 threshold) - ES is in the same risk-index family. Cross-couples to (i) P5 iter 89 row 106 (direct y-axis comparison); (ii) P6 iter 90 row 107 (iter 90's all-9-significantly-below-GRPO is the mean-level signature of iter 101's variance-level eta^2); (iii) P5 iter 93 row 109 (same eta^2 decomposition on a 98-cell mega corpus); (iv) FRONTIER_INSIGHTS Round 1 Critic Degeneracy Hypothesis (the hypothesis is y-axis-conditional, not universal); (v) P5 iter 80/81 row 95/96 MIN-REPORT items 13-17 (motivate a complementary Item 18 on the risk-index y-axis to close the y-axis coverage gap).
